mapper.insert: insert into tb_member ( member_no, member_id, member_pw, member_name, member_phone, member_addr, member_email, member_level, enroll_date ) values ( seq_member.nextval, #{memberId}, #{memberPw}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberAddr}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberLevel}, sysdate )
mapper.select: select member_no, member_id, member_name, member_phone, member_addr, member_email, member_level, enroll_date from tb_member order by member_no

select member_no, member_id, member_name, member_phone, member_addr, member_email, member_level, enroll_date from tb_member
and (upper(member_id) like '%' || upper(#{keyword}) || '%' or upper(member_name) like '%' || upper(#{keyword}) || '%' or upper(member_email) like '%' || upper(#{keyword}) || '%')
and member_level = #{memberLevel}
